2026-06-03 — [more than 5,600 university students were given free satellite access and more than 100 students trained in a Luanda cohort alongside operators and manufacturers](2026-06-03-university-of-namibe-students-free-internet-angosat-2), on a curriculum covering terminal installation, integration, service pricing and billing.

That is a vendor-adjacent skills programme attached to the national satellite rather than a university qualification: no degree, department, laboratory or accreditation is named, and no completion or employment figure follows the cohort.

Nothing else on this ledger describes higher-education provision in a digital field. The education and research network reported under education systems is the nearest institutional item, and it has no connected institutions stated.

summary: Two instruments [opened](2026-05-06-consulta-publica-proposta-de-lei-do-governo-digital) or [closed](2026-06-17-nova-lei-de-proteccao-de-dados-proximo-ano-legislativo) public consultation in the window, on digital government and on data protection.
developments:
2026-05-06 — [public consultation opened on a digital government bill, framed expressly around ending the dispersion of sector rules since 1997 and keeping the digital law and the data-protection law in step](2026-05-06-consulta-publica-proposta-de-lei-do-governo-digital), against [a stated administrative reorganisation running to 2027](2026-03-05-governo-aposta-reorganizacao-administracao-publica-governo-digital-2027). No draft text and no tabling date is held.

2026-06-17 — [consultation closed on the data protection revision](2026-06-17-nova-lei-de-proteccao-de-dados-proximo-ano-legislativo), due at the Council of Ministers and then parliament.

Consultation is happening and its effect is not visible: no source publishes who responded to either exercise, what was said, or what changed in a text as a result. Set against them, parliament rejected the one amendment that would have opened the citizen and electoral databases to parties and citizens, reported under data protection legislation.

progress: Mixed, satellite connectivity reaching new places while the universal service fund has published nothing in sixteen years
summary: Satellite programmes [reached six universities and more than 300 localities without mobile operators](2026-07-13-conecta-angola-20k-students), while [the universal service fund has published no accounts, grant or disbursement](2010-11-26-angola-decreto-presidencial-264-10-fadcom).
developments:
2026-07-13 — the connectivity programme [is stated at six universities and more than 300 localities where mobile operators are absent, with 20,000 students](2026-07-13-conecta-angola-20k-students), against [27 locations and about 366,000 citizens stated to a United Nations body in November 2025](2025-11-28-angola-30000km-terrestrial-fibre-itu-wtdc-baku). The counts are not the same measure and the base cannot net them; [a separate white-space leg connected 3,972 students at two schools](2026-07-14-angola-connects-4000-students-angosat-2-tvws).

Alongside it, [a commercial access hub opened in December 2025 with 37 firms in the integration process by April 2026](2026-04-10-angola-expands-satellite-internet-push-conecta-project), and [a first startup was licensed to resell satellite access in July 2026](2026-07-02-startup-do-moxico-licenca-internet-via-angosat-2).

The instrument built for this has done nothing on the record. [The universal service fund and its 1% levy on telecom operators' gross revenue remain on statute, it may make non-repayable grants for non-commercial universal-service expansion and is barred from subsidising operating costs, and no accounts, grant or disbursement have been published for any year since 2010](2010-11-26-angola-decreto-presidencial-264-10-fadcom).

summary: A statistics development strategy for 2026 to 2032 [was announced as forthcoming, with a statistics-law revision to follow](2026-06-12-nova-estrategia-de-desenvolvimento-da-estatistica-2026-2032).
developments:
2026-06-12 — [a new strategy for the 2026 to 2032 cycle was announced as forthcoming, widening the national statistical system, with a revision of the statistics law to follow](2026-06-12-nova-estrategia-de-desenvolvimento-da-estatistica-2026-2032). None existed before it.

No source confirms that the council session, the law revision or the promised user survey took place, and no strategy document is held. What is on the record is an announcement of an approval that was to come, which is the weakest form of instrument this frame records.

The statistical machinery it would govern is producing: the 2024 census and its portal are reported under censuses and surveys, and the capacity loan behind them under development-partner financing.

summary: The 2024 census [published definitive results in November 2025](2025-11-20-ine-angola-censo-2024-relatorio-sintese-resultados-definitivos) and [a public portal and mobile application in July 2026](2026-07-02-ine-lanca-portal-do-censo-2024-e-aplicacao-movel).
developments:
2025-11-20 — [definitive results of the 2024 census were published](2025-11-20-ine-angola-censo-2024-relatorio-sintese-resultados-definitivos). They are the source of most of what this report can say about the population: identity-card coverage, birth registration and household electricity access all rest on them, and each is reported under its own indicator.

2026-07-02 — [a public portal carrying demographic, social, economic and housing indicators by geographic level, plus a mobile application with macroeconomic series, was launched and built by the statistics office's own staff](2026-07-02-ine-lanca-portal-do-censo-2024-e-aplicacao-movel), where census results had previously been available only as reports.

Behind both, [a US$60m statistical capacity loan has run since 2022 to 2027 supporting statistics-office modernisation, household surveys and dissemination](2022-03-25-wb-ago-002-angola-strengthening-statistical-capacity), with no disbursement, restructuring or results figure on file — it financed the census machinery this report leans on, though no source links the two.

progress: Advanced, a public indicator portal with nothing published about reuse
summary: The census portal [publishes indicators by geographic level](2026-07-02-ine-lanca-portal-do-censo-2024-e-aplicacao-movel), with no open-data licence, bulk download or programming interface stated.
developments:
2026-07-02 — [the statistics office launched a public portal with demographic, social, economic and housing indicators by geographic level, and a mobile application carrying macroeconomic series](2026-07-02-ine-lanca-portal-do-censo-2024-e-aplicacao-movel). It is the only public data publication on this ledger.

No open-data licence, bulk download or programming interface is stated, so what exists is a browsable publication rather than a reusable dataset — and no source records anybody reusing it. No open data policy, no national data portal and no dataset inventory appears anywhere for the country.

The contrast worth drawing is with the registers: the population, social and electoral databases reported under registries are being consolidated at considerable expense, and parliament rejected the one amendment that would have opened any of them.

progress: Mixed, a wholesale partnership signed while a US$170m agreement produced nothing in fourteen months
summary: A wholesale partnership [combined the state cable company's systems with a US network](2026-05-21-angola-cables-uniti-expand-connectivity-itweb), while [a US$170m agreement stands undelivered](2025-06-25-cybastion-angola-telecom-170m-digital-sovereignty).
developments:
2026-05-21 — [a partnership agreement combines the state cable company's three subsea systems with a US network of more than 300 metro markets and 386,000 km of fibre](2026-05-21-angola-cables-uniti-expand-connectivity-itweb), [reported again the following week](2026-05-27-angola-cables-uniti-wholesale-parceria-de-conectividade). No value, term or capacity commitment is stated.

Against it, [an announced US$170m agreement with a US$25m first phase for a national cybersecurity agency, vendor academy training and an undersea cable](2025-06-25-cybastion-angola-telecom-170m-digital-sovereignty) has no disbursement, contract or delivery on record in the fourteen months since [it was announced at a business summit](2025-06-24-cybastion-angola-telecom-acordo-soberania-digital), and no trainee count, cohort or curriculum has been published against its training commitment. Nothing links its agency phase to the cyber centre created by decree six months later.

[A domestic subsea cable to link the coastal cities and connect a transport corridor to international systems is stated as under way](2026-03-26-minttics-projectos-estruturantes-base-tecnologica), and the base names no US instrument, agency or financing behind its digital leg.

progress: Advanced, on memoranda, with no delivery reported against either
summary: A digital-health memorandum [was signed in January 2026 covering 38,000 health workers and 500,000 remote consultations](2026-01-26-angola-huawei-memorando-saude-digital), and [a research centre was pledged by 2027](2025-10-06-huawei-to-build-rd-center-in-angola).
developments:
2026-01-26 — [a four-year memorandum with a Chinese vendor covers training of about 38,000 health workers, more than 500,000 remote consultations, hospital digitisation, telemedicine and health artificial intelligence](2026-01-26-angola-huawei-memorando-saude-digital). No value, milestones or domestic financing are stated, and it was signed for the health ministry by an acting department director rather than the minister. No delivery has been reported.

2025-10-06 — [a research and development centre was announced after a presidential audience, targeted by 2027, with location under evaluation and investment value undefined, paired with a pledge to train 7,000 people in artificial intelligence and emerging technologies by 2027](2025-10-06-huawei-to-build-rd-center-in-angola), [as reported from the audience itself](2025-10-02-huawei-centro-de-pesquisa-e-desenvolvimento-angola-2027). Nothing has been recorded in the ten months since.

The substantive Chinese engagement on this ledger is not a memorandum at all: it is the concessional loan behind the national broadband network, reported under the fibre backbone, which has no progress report on file at either end.

summary: A French-financed earth-observation satellite [passed a system milestone in May 2026](2026-05-14-angeo-1-airbus-system-key-point-milestone) and is under construction, on [about EUR 225m secured in January 2025](2025-01-23-angola-and-france-secure-225-million-for-satellite-projects).
developments:
2026-05-14 — [a system key-point milestone was validated on the earth-observation satellite](2026-05-14-angeo-1-airbus-system-key-point-milestone), which [entered construction after a March 2026 kick-off with first ground infrastructure delivered from June 2026 and a design of more than 1,000 high-resolution images a day](2026-03-16-arranque-do-projecto-angeo-1-airbus). [Financing of about EUR 225m was signed with France in January 2025](2025-01-23-angola-and-france-secure-225-million-for-satellite-projects), with no build started at that point.

No launch date is published, and no source states what the imagery is for: no agricultural, meteorological, cadastral or disaster-response programme on this ledger names it as a source.

It is the largest single European commitment on the ledger and the only one with construction behind it.

summary: A Gulf digital memorandum in force since 2021 [has produced no deliverable report, valuation or successor since 2023](2023-02-15-angola-minttics-cloud-nacional-ecossistema-digital).
developments:
[The memorandum has been in force since December 2021, its agreed heads a three-year digitalisation master plan, public-private-partnership and build-operate-transfer financing, and youth digital skills](2021-12-21 Government of Angola and Presight sign MoU for Digital Angola program). [The telecommunications ministry attributed the national cloud implementation project to it in February 2023](2023-02-15-angola-minttics-cloud-nacional-ecossistema-digital).

Nothing has been published since. No deliverable report, valuation or successor instrument exists on the record, the memorandum text itself is not published, and the ministry's account and the vendor's are the only sources for any of it.

The national cloud it was credited with is now in operation, reported under data storage, and no source connects the delivered system back to this memorandum.
